title: Batch 2: three-file mobile candidate validated; deployment awaits approval
summary: Parent animation experiment improved median lab LCP 4.448 to 3.904 seconds with CLS zero. Responsive category requests measured 494,302 to 20,801 bytes at 256px. Final build and browser checks passed; production remains unchanged.

changes.detail: Only page-wide opacity/blur/transform entrance and its unused keyframes removed; accent and other component animations remain.
Category pictures use existing Next image optimizer, viewport sizes, preserved mobile/desktop crop and lazy loading. Originals recover after early or late optimizer failure.
320px hero and Ecomedia overflow corrected. Narrowest hero actions stack with readable French labels and at least 48px touch height.

validation.name: Performance experiment
validation.detail: Three interleaved samples per arm; baseline 4.348–4.540s, animation-disabled 3.876–4.004s; median gain 544ms (12.2%). CLS zero. Browser-only experiment on live source, not final production field results. Target 2.5s unmet.

validation.name: Final production build, TypeScript, lint
validation.detail: Normal npm run build including prebuild passed. Focused lint has two existing homepage warnings, no errors. Rebuilds were required by visual and image-race corrections.

validation.name: Browser and preservation
validation.detail: 33 candidate checks including 320/375/390/1440, reduced motion, category fallback with delayed scripts, navigation and images; 24 checkout checks; 39 focused checkout/security tests; 7 local SEO checks. All 2,051 other source files byte-identical to live.

validation.name: Production and limitations
validation.detail: No deployment attempted. Exact target and rollback rechecked. No field INP, physical-device or real transaction validation. Candidate-local fixture previews do not represent updated production.
